# Max Flooring NW LLC

> Hardwood floor sanding and refinishing, gym and school floor refinishing, and hardwood, engineered and LVP installation. Based in Chelan, Washington. Serves Chelan, Manson, Entiat, Chelan Falls, Wenatchee and central and western Washington.

- Owner/operator: Maxwell Callero
- Phone/text: 253-653-9743
- Email: MaxFlooringNW@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Free estimates
